what_buyers_expect: A documented, continuously updated risk management process covering foreseeable misuse and residual risk.
Training/validation/testing data provenance, bias examination and mitigation.
Technical documentation drawn up before market placement and kept up to date (Annex IV contents).
Automatic event logging over the system's lifetime, enabling traceability and monitoring.
Instructions for use giving deployers the system's capabilities, limits, accuracy and oversight measures.
Design measures that let natural persons oversee, interpret, override or stop the system.
Declared accuracy metrics, robustness measures and cybersecurity controls.
A written quality management system covering design, testing, change control and accountability.
Status of the conformity assessment procedure followed before placing the system on the market.
Registration of the system in the EU database for high-risk systems.
A post-market monitoring plan that actively collects and analyses performance data over the lifetime.
A procedure to detect, investigate and report serious incidents to market surveillance authorities.
Measures ensuring staff and deployers' operators have sufficient AI literacy.

topic: Right to explanation of individual decisions
what_buyers_expect: Ability for deployers to give affected persons a clear explanation of the system's role in a decision.
